newsitem.title: USA: Owens & Minor says will create network with GE.
newsitem.headline: Owens & Minor says will create network with GE.

text.p: Owens & Minor Inc said on Tuesday it has formed an alliance with GE Information Services to reduce the costs of moving supplies throughout the healthcare supply chain.

Owens & Minor said the alliance will create a network to bring together best-of-class suppliers and leading edge open systems to streamline order and distribution management processes for the integrated healthcare system.

Owens & Minor said the value network uses standard and open systems technologies, such as the Internet, so participants can share information in a timely manner and in a format suitable for their needs.
